name: match_id
description: Match identifier, 1..104 in chronological order.

name: match_date
description: Date of the match.

name: kickoff_local
description: Local kick-off time with UTC offset, e.g. '13:00 UTC-6'.

name: stage
description: Stage: Group stage, Round of 32, Round of 16, Quarter-final, Semi-final, Third place, Final.

name: stage_order
description: Stage order for sorting: 1 = Group stage ... 7 = Final.

name: group_letter
description: Group letter A..L for group-stage matches, NULL otherwise.

name: home_team
description: First-named team.

name: away_team
description: Second-named team.

name: home_score
description: Home goals after extra time (penalty shoot-out excluded).

name: away_score
description: Away goals after extra time (penalty shoot-out excluded).

name: home_score_90
description: Home goals after 90 minutes.

name: away_score_90
description: Away goals after 90 minutes.

name: extra_time
description: TRUE if the match went to extra time.

name: home_penalties
description: Home penalty shoot-out score, NULL if no shoot-out.

name: away_penalties
description: Away penalty shoot-out score, NULL if no shoot-out.

name: winner
description: Winning team (including on penalties), NULL for a draw.

name: venue
description: Stadium and city.

name: attendance
description: Spectators.

name: referee
description: Main referee.

name: referee_country
description: 3-letter code of the referee's country.
